card.name: Decimal point in 6.25 doses
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after the digit 6 when it begins the dose number 6.25, usually before mg or mg/kg.

modes.label: Starting dose 6.25 mg
modes.description: The point in 6.25 as a starting or low dose of a tablet such as carvedilol.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose of Carvedilol Tablet is 6<<.>>25 mg twice daily.

modes.label: 6.25 in dose ranges or tables
modes.description: The point in 6.25 inside a range, a weight-based dose, or a dosing table.
modes.example: hydrochlorothiazide doses of 6<<.>>25 mg to 25 mg

card.writes: It pushes toward quarter-related tokens, matching the quarter-like value 6.25 (a quarter of 25).
card.plain: It fires on the decimal point in the dose 6.25, a number that is a quarter of 25.
